noted-rag embedder. Pooling needs the whole sequence in one physical batch;
batch/ubatch = context so any single 700-1000 token chunk fits.
parallel=1: single slot. Each active slot retains a large 8192-batch
buffer; under concurrent load (bulk ingest + live search/chat) multiple
slots activate and memory ratchets to OOM (~84GB observed). One slot
queues concurrent embeds instead -> bounded ~4GB. Context stays 8192 so
no sequence is ever truncated; only embedding parallelism is reduced.
noted-rag reranker. query + </s></s> + chunk pairs exceed 512 tokens;
pooling forbids chunked prefill, so batch/ubatch = context.
